description: Analog partition testbenches: the characterization bench behind the committed TT/1.20V/25C Liberty view -- the pure klt characterize request builder, the runner that drives klt and appends the append-only evidence record (capturing the IHP-Open-PDK revision of the --pdk-dir checkout before anything is written), the freshness checker that re-derives the committed view's provenance claims, the harness modules they import, the netlist generator and the config every measurement is made from. The attested cold start (sh sim/characterize/cold_start.sh) is honestly lighter than the bench: it runs the request-construction tests (python3 -m unittest sim.characterize.tests.test_request) and the freshness checker (python3 -m sim.characterize.check_library) -- both tool-free, stdlib Python only, and the checker fails on any stale or tampered committed artifact (config bytes, record, PDK pin, provenance stamps). It does NOT re-run the characterization itself: that needs klt, ngspice and an IHP-Open-PDK git checkout at the pinned commit, and is recorded in documented_argv below and spelled out, PDK checkout included, in README.md 'Reproducing the characterization'. Later benches (klt sim, klt pex -- issues #180/#181) extend this inventory instead of adding a second one.
